dispatch: frozen original GPU dispatch; prices do not change routing or capacities
cost: all-site modeled GPU kWh times assumed volumetric site price; excludes PPA contract rights, clean procurement terms, taxes, egress, hardware reservation and other charges
fee: (v * avoided uncovered MWh - modeled volumetric cost change) / routed request equivalents; v is a hypothetical shadow value; a negative threshold means this selected pricing/value scenario provides no positive fee margin
